prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1137; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of neck and back pain consistent with strain. Over the course of 30 visits, care included passive modalities, home exercise instruction, and progressive mobility work. Treatment followed a typical course and tapered as symptoms improved and range of motion returned toward baseline. Examination revealed some objective findings, including paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical rotation, which support a soft tissue injury, while other neurological and orthopedic tests remained within normal limits. The patient reported a remote, small strain to the same region years ago that resolved completely without lasting limitation. At this time, it is not yet clear whether the current injury is entirely attributable to this collision, and further correlation with the imaging and prior records is recommended. Billing review shows no repeated or duplicate charges for services rendered.
